 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   The 

 3   Senate will come to order.  

 4                I would ask that everyone please 

 5   rise and join me in the Pledge of Allegiance to 

 6   our Flag.

 7                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 8   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:   We are 

10   joined today by the Reverend Edward VanKampen, 

11   pastor of the Nassau Reformed Church.

12                REVEREND VANKAMPEN:   Let us pray.

13                Almighty God, You have given us the 

14   great land and resources in the State of 

15   New York for which we are grateful.  It is our 

16   heritage, and with it we are blessed.  Make us 

17   always remember to use it constantly as You 

18   will.

19                Forgive, we pray, our shortcomings.  

20   Purify our hearts to see and love truth.  Give 

21   wisdom to our counselors and steadfastness to 

22   our people.  And bring us at last to the fair 

23   city of peace whose foundations are mercy, 

24   justice and goodwill, and whose builder and 

25   maker You are.


                                                                447

 1                Bless those who hold office in the 

 2   government of this state, that they may do their 

 3   work in the spirit of wisdom, kindness and 

 4   justice.  Help them use their authority to serve 

 5   faithfully and to promote the general welfare of 

 6   all.  

 7                Provide that they always remember 

 8   Your generosity and constantly do Your will, 

 9   O God; that they serve to bring and maintain our 

10   state with honest industry and sound learning 

11   and an honorable way of life; that they save all 

12   peoples of our state from violence, discord and 

13   confusion, from pride and arrogance and from 

14   every evil way.

15                O God, we commend all that we are 

16   and all that we shall become to Your merciful 

17   care, that we may live securely in peace and be 

18   guided by Your providence.  Guide all who lead 

19   and all who follow to remember we are called to 

20   serve one another as lovers of truth and 

21   justice.  

22                Now and forever, amen.

23                ACTING PRESIDENT O'MARA:  Thank 

24   you, Reverend.  

25                Senator Libous.

11                SENATOR GIANARIS:   Thank you, 

12   Mr. President.  

13                This past weekend we lost a former 

14   member of this body who was beloved on both 

15   sides of the aisle.  George Onorato was someone 

16   who dedicated his life to service -- first as a 

17   member of the military, then as a labor leader, 

18   and for 27 years as a member of this body, where 

19   I daresay, if I could speak on behalf of all of 

20   my colleagues in a bipartisan fashion, he was 

21   one of the most beloved members not only among 

22   his colleagues but even among the staff here.  I 

23   know that the sergeant-at-arms, even to this 

24   day, would ask me how George was doing.

25                Unfortunately, his health caught up 


                                                                449

 1   with him this past weekend.  

 2                I know everyone who knew him here 

 3   knew how close he was and how he always had his 

 4   wife Athena by his side even when in Albany.  And 

 5   now as he rests, he's by her side once again, as 

 6   she passed just a couple of years ago as well. 

 7                So if we could open the session with 

 8   a moment of silence in his honor, I'd appreciate 

 9   it, Mr. President.
